sol-3-1.summary: AudienceOptions is a handwritten pure configuration interface instead of a schema-derived executable contract.
sol-3-1.fix: Define identity- and field-annotated AudienceOptions = S.Struct({ envVar: S.optionalKey(S.String) }) and derive its same-name type. Preserve plain objects, omitted keys, all strings, Audience.layer behavior and the type-only barrel export. Add focused schema acceptance and layer compatibility checks in Audience.test.ts without rewriting upstream assertions. Defer D10 properties and S2 conversion; central codemod owns added-export bookkeeping.

sol-3-2.summary: RuntimeEnvOverrides lacks schema ownership of its optional Option-valued agent, CI and terminal configuration fields.
sol-3-2.fix: Define identity- and field-annotated RuntimeEnvOverrides as S.Struct with optional keys containing S.Option(S.String), S.Option(CiName) and S.Option(DetectedTerminal), then derive its same-name type. Preserve plain objects, absent keys, explicit None, accepted terminal values, layerTest defaults and the type-only barrel export. Add focused acceptance and layerTest compatibility checks in RuntimeEnv.test.ts without weakening upstream assertions. Defer D10 properties and S2 conversion; central codemod owns added-export bookkeeping.

sol-3-3.summary: TerminalEnvTestOptions independently declares a pure configuration payload instead of deriving it from schemas.
sol-3-3.fix: Derive an annotated partial stream schema from StreamEnv with optional fields; define identity- and field-annotated TerminalEnvTestOptions as S.Struct with optional stdinIsTerminal, stdout and stderr keys and derive its same-name type. Preserve plain partial objects, omitted fields, quiet defaults, non-finite columns and the type-only barrel export. Reuse StreamEnv's full number domain and reasoned schemaNumber exception; do not substitute S.Finite. Add focused acceptance and layerTest compatibility checks in TerminalEnv.test.ts without weakening upstream assertions. Defer D10 properties and S2 conversion; central codemod owns added-export bookkeeping.
